questions.text: The table shows the number of seats allocated to four states in the Rajya Sabha and their respective populations (in crores) as per Census 2011. Which state has the highest representation ratio (Seats per Crore population)?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Calculate Seats/Population for each. State W: 11/6 = 1.83. State X: 16/9 = 1.77. State Y: 19/11 = 1.72. State Z: 7/3 = 2.33. Highest is State Z. Trick: Look for smallest population with relatively high seats. State Z has only 3 Cr pop but 7 seats. Step-by-step: 1. Ratio W = 11/6 ≈ 1.83. 2. Ratio X = 16/9 ≈ 1.78. 3. Ratio Y = 19/11 ≈ 1.73. 4. Ratio Z = 7/3 ≈ 2.33. 5. State Z has the highest ratio.

questions.text: Which Constitutional Amendment Act inserted the Tenth Schedule, containing provisions for disqualification on grounds of defection, into the Constitution of India?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Link Schedule number to subject. 10th Schedule = Anti-Defection = 52nd Amendment (1985). Eliminate 42nd (Mini Constitution), 73rd (Panchayati Raj), 91st (Strengthened Anti-Defection later). Worked: The Tenth Schedule was added by the 52nd Amendment Act, 1985, during the Rajiv Gandhi government to curb political defections. The 91st Amendment Act, 2003, later amended the Tenth Schedule to make disqualification more stringent. The 73rd Amendment (1992) added Part IX (Panchayats) and the 42nd Amendment (1976) is known as the 'Mini Constitution'.

questions.text: Which of the following rivers is a major right-bank tributary of the River Ganga?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Classify by origin. Right-bank tributaries (Peninsular origin): Yamuna, Son. Left-bank tributaries (Himalayan origin): Ghaghara, Gandak, Kosi, Gomati. Eliminate the three Himalayan rivers (Ghaghara, Gandak, Kosi) to select Son. Worked: The Ganga receives tributaries from the Himalayas (left bank/North) and the Peninsular Plateau (right bank/South). Ghaghara, Gandak, and Kosi are major snow-fed Himalayan rivers joining from the left. The Son originates from the Amarkantak plateau in Madhya Pradesh and joins the Ganga near Patna (Bihar) from the right bank, making it a principal right-bank tributary along with the Yamuna.

questions.text: As per the table below showing the production of Rice and Wheat (in '000 tonnes) in four states, which state has the highest ratio of Rice production to Wheat production? | State | Rice | Wheat | |-------|------|-------| | A | 120 | 80 | | B | 150 | 90 | | C | 180 | 100 | | D | 200 | 120 |
questions.solution: Shortcut: Compare ratios using cross-multiplication or quick decimal approximation. A: 120/80 = 1.5; B: 150/90 ≈ 1.67; C: 180/100 = 1.8; D: 200/120 ≈ 1.67. Highest is 1.8 (State C). Worked: Calculate Rice/Wheat for each. State A = 3/2 = 1.5. State B = 5/3 ≈ 1.667. State C = 9/5 = 1.8. State D = 5/3 ≈ 1.667. State C has the maximum ratio.

questions.text: What is the unit digit of the expression (7^95 + 3^58)?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Use cyclicity of unit digits (cycle of 4). For 7^95, 95 mod 4 = 3 → unit digit of 7^3 = 3. For 3^58, 58 mod 4 = 2 → unit digit of 3^2 = 9. Sum = 3 + 9 = 12 → unit digit 2. Worked: Cyclicity of 7 is 7, 9, 3, 1. 95 = 4×23 + 3, so 3rd position = 3. Cyclicity of 3 is 3, 9, 7, 1. 58 = 4×14 + 2, so 2nd position = 9. 3 + 9 = 12, unit digit is 2.

questions.text: The Panna Biosphere Reserve, included in the UNESCO World Network of Biosphere Reserves (WNBR) in 2020, is located in which Indian state?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Map famous Tiger Reserves/Parks to States. Panna = Khajuraho/Ken River = Madhya Pradesh. Eliminate Karnataka (Bandipur/Nagarhole), Odisha (Simlipal), Assam (Kaziranga/Manas). Worked: Panna National Park, located in Panna and Chhatarpur districts of Madhya Pradesh, was declared a Tiger Reserve in 1994 and a Biosphere Reserve in 2011. It lies in the Vindhya mountain range and the Ken River flows through it. It was designated a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve in 2020. Karnataka hosts Nilgiri and Bandipur; Odisha hosts Simlipal; Assam hosts Kaziranga, Manas, and Dibru-Saikhowa in the WNBR.

questions.text: According to the Climate Change Performance Index (CCPI) 2024 released at COP28, which of the following statements regarding India's performance is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: India slipped to 10th rank due to increased reliance on coal-fired power plants.

options.label: B
options.text: India secured the 7th rank, maintaining its position among the top 10 performers.

options.label: C
options.text: India achieved the 4th rank, becoming the highest-ranked G20 country.

options.label: D
options.text: India was ranked 15th, categorized as a 'Low' performer in the GHG Emissions category.

questions.solution: Shortcut: Elimination by Rank Knowledge. CCPI leaves top 3 ranks empty (no country meets 1.5°C path). Denmark is usually 4th. India has consistently been in top 10 (8th in 2023). Option C (4th) is impossible (top 3 empty, Denmark 4th). Option A (10th) and D (15th) indicate a drop, but news highlighted India *improving* or maintaining high rank. Option B (7th) matches the reported improvement from 8th to 7th. Full Solution: CCPI 2024 (published Nov 2023 by Germanwatch, CAN, NewClimate Institute) ranked India 7th (up from 8th in 2023). The top three ranks remain vacant. Denmark ranked 4th. India received 'High' ratings in GHG Emissions and Energy Use, 'Medium' in Climate Policy and Renewable Energy. It was the highest-ranked G20 country (but at 7th, not 4th).

questions.text: In a certain code language, 'PLANT' is written as 'KOZMG'. How will 'FARMER' be written in that code?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Detect reverse alphabet pairing (Atbash cipher) where sum of positions = 27 (A=1, Z=26). Verify: P(16)+K(11)=27, L(12)+O(15)=27. Apply to FARMER: F(6)→U(21), A(1)→Z(26), R(18)→I(9), M(13)→N(14), E(5)→V(22), R(18)→I(9). Worked: Each letter is replaced by its reverse counterpart (A↔Z, B↔Y...). F→U, A→Z, R→I, M→N, E→V, R→I. Code is UZINVI.

questions.text: The table below shows the Forest Cover (in sq km) and the percentage increase in forest cover between two assessment cycles for four states. Which state recorded the maximum absolute increase in forest cover (in sq km)?
questions.solution: Shortcut (Approximation/Option Elimination): Absolute Increase = Base Cover * (% Increase / 100). Estimate: P: 50,000 * 2% = 1,000. Q: 75,000 * 1% = 750. R: 20,000 * 10% = 2,000. S: 10,000 * 15% = 1,500. State R (2,000) is clearly highest. Full Solution: P = 50,000 * 0.02 = 1,000 sq km. Q = 75,000 * 0.01 = 750 sq km. R = 20,000 * 0.10 = 2,000 sq km. S = 10,000 * 0.15 = 1,500 sq km. Maximum is State R.

questions.text: The table below shows the number of Lok Sabha seats and the population (in lakhs) as per Census 2011 for four states. Which state has the highest representation ratio (Seats per 10 lakh population)?
questions.solution: Shortcut (Cross-Multiplication/Ratio Comparison): Compare Seats/Pop ratios without division. Compare A (10/500 = 1/50) vs B (20/1200 = 1/60). 1/50 > 1/60, so A > B. Compare A vs C (30/1800 = 1/60). A > C. Compare A vs D (5/200 = 1/40). 1/40 > 1/50, so D > A. State D has highest ratio. Full Solution: Calculate ratio for each: A=10/500=0.02, B=20/1200=0.0167, C=30/1800=0.0167, D=5/200=0.025. State D (0.025) is highest.

questions.text: As per the table below showing Capital Expenditure (Capex) Outlay in the Interim Budget 2024-25, what is the approximate percentage increase in the Budget Estimate (BE) 2024-25 over the Revised Estimate (RE) 2023-24? | Category | Revised Estimate 2023-24 (Rs Lakh Crore) | Budget Estimate 2024-25 (Rs Lakh Crore) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Capital Expenditure | 9.50 | 11.11 |
questions.solution: Shortcut: Approximation. Increase = 11.11 - 9.50 = 1.61. Base = 9.50. 10% of base = 0.95. 20% of base = 1.90. The increase (1.61) is between 10% and 20%, closer to 1.70 (approx 18%). Check 17%: 9.5 * 0.17 = 1.615. Matches perfectly. Full Solution: Percentage Increase = [(BE - RE) / RE] * 100 = [(11.11 - 9.50) / 9.50] * 100 = (1.61 / 9.50) * 100 = 16.947% ≈ 17.0%. The Interim Budget 2024-25 pegged Capex at Rs 11.11 lakh crore (3.4% of GDP) vs RE 2023-24 of Rs 9.5 lakh crore.

questions.text: As per the Census 2011 data provided in the table, which state has the highest difference between its Urban and Rural literacy rates?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Calculate Urban - Rural for each. State A: 88-72=16. State B: 90-80=10. State C: 92-65=27. State D: 85-75=10. Max is State C (27). No calculation needed for B and D if you spot the pattern (both 10). Compare A (16) vs C (27). Step-by-step: 1. Compute difference for State A: 88 - 72 = 16. 2. State B: 90 - 80 = 10. 3. State C: 92 - 65 = 27. 4. State D: 85 - 75 = 10. 5. Highest difference is 27 for State C.

questions.text: With reference to the Constitution (One Hundred and Sixth Amendment) Act, 2023 (Nari Shakti Vandan Adhiniyam), which of the following statements is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: It provides for reservation of seats for women in the Rajya Sabha and State Legislative Councils.

options.label: B
options.text: The reservation shall come into effect immediately upon the assent of the President.

options.label: C
options.text: The reservation will cease to have effect on the expiration of a period of fifteen years from the commencement of the Act.

options.label: D
options.text: The rotation of reserved seats for women shall take effect after every general election to the Lok Sabha.

questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate options using key constraints. Option A is wrong because Rajya Sabha/Legislative Councils are excluded. Option B is wrong because implementation is contingent on the first Census after commencement and subsequent delimitation, not immediate. Option D is wrong because rotation occurs after each *delimitation* exercise, not every general election. Option C matches the explicit sunset clause (Article 334A) stating 15 years. Full Solution: The 106th Amendment inserts Articles 330A, 332A, and 334A. It reserves 1/3rd seats in Lok Sabha and State Assemblies (not Upper Houses). Article 334A stipulates the reservation ceases after 15 years from commencement. Implementation requires a Census and Delimitation exercise (not immediate). Rotation of seats occurs after each subsequent delimitation.

questions.text: As per the table below showing the subjects listed under the Seventh Schedule of the Constitution of India (Union, State, and Concurrent Lists), which of the following subjects is correctly matched with its respective List?
questions.solution: Shortcut: Eliminate using federal logic. Police and Public Order are quintessential State subjects (Entry 2, List II) → Eliminate A. Banking is a Union subject (Entry 45, List I) → Eliminate B. Agriculture is a State subject (Entry 14, List II) → Eliminate D. Education was moved to Concurrent List (Entry 25, List III) by the 42nd Amendment → Option C remains. Full Solution: Seventh Schedule: Police (State List), Banking (Union List), Education (Concurrent List since 1976), Agriculture (State List). Only Option C is correct.

questions.text: As per the data table below showing the population of four states in Census 2001 and 2011, which state recorded the highest decadal growth rate (2001-2011)?
questions.solution: Shortcut (Ratio Elimination): Growth Rate approx = (Pop2011 / Pop2001). Compare ratios directly. S1: 110/100 = 1.10. S2: 132/100 = 1.32. S3: 210/200 = 1.05. S4: 160/150 = 1.066. Highest ratio is State 2 (1.32). Full Solution: Growth Rate = [(Pop2011 - Pop2001) / Pop2001] * 100. S1: 10%. S2: 32%. S3: 5%. S4: 6.67%. State 2 has highest growth rate.
